title: Sunshine Chateau
meta_description: Sunshine Chateau by AvantStay: a bright coastal getaway with ocean views, easy beach access, and a complimentary golf cart.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Sunshine Chateau by AvantStay!

Just moments from the sugar-white shores of Panama City Beach, Sunshine Chateau offers a cheerful coastal escape where bright interiors, ocean views, and easy beach access set the tone for an effortless getaway. This vibrant home sits in one of the area's most beloved beach corridors---close to scenic Highway 30, local restaurants, and family-friendly attractions like Pier Park and Conservation Park---while still feeling wonderfully quiet and relaxed.

Inside, the living room channels an "under-the-sea" theme with calming blues, comfortable seating, and plenty of natural light. The full kitchen is equipped with stainless-steel appliances and everything you need for easy meals between beach runs. Step outside to the backyard, where a colorful mural, rocking chairs, and a breezy patio create a playful outdoor hangout everyone will love. Sip morning coffee on the second-floor balcony overlooking the neighborhood or settle in at the charming bistro table near the entrance for a sunny moment before heading out.

The home's two bedrooms offer thoughtful comfort for groups and families. The primary bedroom features a king-sized bed and soothing coastal décor, while the second bedroom is designed with versatility in mind---offering a queen bed plus a twin daybed with a twin trundle (pullout), perfect for kids or friends. A full bathroom serves the bedrooms upstairs, while a convenient half bath sits on the main level.

With a complimentary golf cart to cruise to the beach in minutes, a welcoming coastal atmosphere, and sleeping space for up to seven guests, Sunshine Chateau makes every day feel like a bright, breezy vacation.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- On-site parking for up to 2 cars; please note the golf cart occupies 1 driveway space.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)

all: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
